name: portainer
description: Portainer CE/BE API — observe and control your own Docker infrastructure: environments, stacks, compose definitions; v0.2 adds redeploy/start/stop write actions (approval-gated). Self-hosted: base_url must point at YOUR Portainer instance.
author: Kestrel

api_key.description: Portainer API key (user -> API keys in the UI). Prefer a dedicated read-mostly user.

base_url.description: Your Portainer instance root (e.g. https://portainer.example.com). Required; no public default.

writes_enabled.description: Arm the write lane (stack start/stop/redeploy/update, webhook create/delete). Default false. Commands remain confirm-gated (confirm="<target name>") and audit-logged. Guards accidental actions, not hostile callers — see docs/WRITE-LANE-DESIGN.md.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Portainer version + instance id. Works even without a valid API key — pre-flight/clock sanity.

commands.name: endpoints list
commands.description: Environments (Docker/Swarm/K8s) known to this Portainer, with id/name/type/url/group.

commands.name: stacks list
commands.description: Stacks with id/name/type/status/endpoint. Optional filters: endpoint_id, name.

commands.name: stack get
commands.description: One stack in full: status, dates, git metadata, webhook presence.

commands.name: stack start
commands.description: Start a stopped stack. Write lane: requires writes_enabled=true state and confirm="<stack name>".

commands.name: stack stop
commands.description: Stop an active stack (availability only; volumes/definitions untouched). Write lane gates apply.

commands.name: stack redeploy
commands.description: Git-backed stacks: pull current source and redeploy (prune always false). Write lane gates apply.

commands.name: stack update
commands.description: Replace a stack's stored compose definition. Result carries a line diff of the change. Write lane gates apply.

commands.name: webhook delete
commands.description: Delete a webhook by id. Confirm = the webhook id as a string. Write lane gates apply.
